title: Shaadi card app

beats.say: Mum got a wedding card that wants to be installed.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta Sharma aunty ki beti ki shaadi ka card aaya. Khul nahi raha, Install bol raha hai??

beats.say: Done! I said yes for all four of you!
Great question! A wedding card is like a mithai box. You just open it.
Asks to be installed? That's a stranger wanting your house keys, and your OTPs.

screen.title: To Mum
screen.body:
1. A real card is a photo or PDF. Never an app.
2. Says Install? Don't tap. Delete it.
3. Settings > search 'Install unknown apps' > WhatsApp: OFF
4. Money gone? Call 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Samajh gayi beta.
Warning 14 groups mein forward kar di.

beats.say: She forwarded the warning. To fourteen groups.
beats.show: She forwarded the warning. To 14 groups.

caption:
mum got a shaadi card on whatsapp. it wanted to be installed.

a real wedding card is a photo or a pdf. if it asks you to install something, it's an app that can read your messages and OTPs. delete it, and if money is gone call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
